items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Alla say, "You wanta record?" I say, "Yeah!" ... So we done all that, an' we wound up recordin' all them on all them different labels.

ctx.x: Now, don't ask me. I never wasn't that worried about who owned them. All I wanted was the money. I was takin' it easy. I didn't ask no questions.

Alla say, "You wanta record?"
I say, "Yeah!"
"You got somethin' t'record?"
"Yeah."
"Got some o' your own stuff?"
"Yeah!"
